mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_monitor_log (source, level, message) VALUES (#{source}, #{level}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_monitor_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM t_monitor_log WHERE source = #{source} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_monitor_log WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{keepDays} DAY)
